title: Edition der Familienkorrespondenz Ferdinands I. (Family correspondence of Ferdinand I)
author: Ferdinand I and his family (Charles V, Margaret, Mary of Hungary and others)
institution: Commission for Modern Austrian History, Universität Salzburg (Christopher F. Laferl) and ACDH-CH (Austrian Academy of Sciences)
region: Habsburg lands, Spain and the Low Countries
notes: Digital version of the first volume (1912, edited by Wilhelm Bauer) of the family correspondence of Ferdinand I, letters A1-A261 of 1514-1526; the later printed volumes (to 1536) and the letter lists for 1537-1564 are announced, not yet online. Each letter page gives the transcription with German and English summaries, notes and indexes, and a link to the TEI file (data/dtabf_id/band_001/A###.xml). The index lists 262 letter records; 201 carry transcribed text and 61 are asterisked entries with a summary or cross-reference only. The TEI headers state CC BY 3.0; the TEI files were last modified 1 October 2024. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
